when: when the full suite is green (./test/run-all.sh) and the artifact is verified (npm pack file list + clean-room load) and the bump is patch or minor → publish automatically; when the bump would be major → send for final review; when the suite is not green or verification fails → fix first, never publish; when npm credentials are missing (npm whoami fails) → stop and tell the user
how:
To publish pi-aia-asf (the ASF itself):

1. Verify first per references/07-release.md: full suite green (./test/run-all.sh), typecheck (npm run check — if typescript is not installed locally, use a local tsc from another project's node_modules), all MUST specs met, SCA re-run (npm audit).
2. Choose the bump: patch = bugfix, minor = new features (backward compatible), major = breaking changes (major → send for final review per the when rules).
3. Ensure CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entries are complete and specific — no placeholders.
4. Connect with npm: verify `npm whoami` (credentials in ~/.npmrc, 2FA token); if not logged in, run `npm login` (user action) and stop.
5. Sync git: ensure a clean working tree (git status), `git pull --rebase` if a remote is configured.
6. Run `npm run release <level>` — the repo's release script (scripts/release.sh): bumps package.json, inserts the version section in CHANGELOG.md, commits, creates an annotated tag, pushes with --follow-tags, runs npm publish.
7. After the script: replace the placeholder '### Added' entry it inserts with the real changes, commit (or amend) and push.
8. Test on publish: `npm view pi-aia-asf version` must match the tag; install clean-room from the registry in a fresh dir with caches cleared (06b Rule 5) and confirm the skill loads and the extension registers (observable end state).
9. If publish fails partway: fix forward; never publish a second version with the same number. If it is an auth/2FA failure, stop and tell the user.
10. Report: version, tag, npm URL, verification result (06b Rule 11 — say explicitly what was and was not verified).

Apply the ASF's own discipline while driving: bounded waits (06b Rule 15), verify the artifact not the source (06b Rule 1), report honestly (06b Rule 11).
